plugins.name: human-edit
plugins.description: human_edit tool: the agent asks the user to edit a file in a tmux split pane and waits until the editor exits

plugins.name: next-step
plugins.description: After each turn, asks a small model for up to four prompts the user is likely to send next and shows them as cards above the prompt; clicking a card sends its prompt

plugins.name: publish-guard
plugins.description: Before the agent pushes from a repository that has scripts/check-public.sh, runs that check and blocks the push when it finds names or keys that must not be published

plugins.name: rich
plugins.description: show tool: the agent draws cards, a box-and-arrow diagram, tables and clickable questions inline in the transcript or in a pane

plugins.name: status-band
plugins.description: A line under the prompt that replaces the status line: model, context use, directory, jj counts and the pull requests this session created or edited, with panes for the jj log and the pull requests

plugins.name: devrep
plugins.description: update_devrep tool: while turned on for a session, the agent keeps a short report of where the work stands (doing now, next, and free sections) in a pane, so the user can pick the session back up without reading the transcript
